summary: Make the before-action reaction window a true multi-reaction alternating window (Mendon's ruling on the Akodo Kakihara known limit, follow-up to #305/PR #308). Shared lane: the rules change in src/L5R.Core is the substance; the routing also sees one AI regression test (tests/L5R.AI.Tests) and the legal-action listing (MatchQueries). Every applicable reaction (Rokai, Tamoko, Champion of Thunder, Brothers of Goemon, Kakihara, any future watcher) of BOTH players is takeable: the turn player has the first opportunity when they hold a reaction, then the other player, alternating via the existing PassReaction/NextAction machinery until both pass consecutively, then the deferred command resolves. BeforeActionReactionApplies is the single live eligibility source (window opening, QueryActions, ValidateAbility), so eligibility is re-evaluated at every opportunity. FirstReactionOpportunity/OpenAlternatingReactionWindow are generic for the Engage window (#310). MatchState.NegatedEffects (a composable list) replaces the single negation pair. Kakihara's bonus is added directly so a Champion cannot cancel it. The Attack window (previously attacked-side-first) follows the same first-opportunity rule. QueryActions offers each player their own reactions. Decision doc rewritten: known-limit paragraph removed, ruling recorded.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests 206/206 core, 57/57 published; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all green (python 43+130, gold-parity 18, gold-quote 20, L5R.AI.Tests 15, L5R.Server.Tests 6, L5R.Client.Transport.Tests 5). Seven new core tests plus one AI test (turn-player-first alternation, pass/react/react, both-pass-immediately, same-player reactions in either order, Rokai+Kakihara, Champion+Kakihara, mid-window eligibility removal, composing negations, listing per player and no-deadlock, determinism, attack-window alignment, unusable/inapplicable reactions). 18 targeted logic mutations: all killed except one equivalent (single-purpose negation never consumed: no current ability hits one card with the same effect kind twice). No wave file or published-count change: pinned count stays 390 (origin/main baseline, re-derived by counting content/published). Godot client not built locally (no client change); left to CI.
remaining: Documented, not silent: targeting means command.TargetId only; Unimpeachable Name (a hand card, before-any-action-resolves) is still its own separate window, only consulted when no before-action window opened for the command, not folded into this one.
